name: release-testing-coverage-and-outcome-reporter
description: Reports which deployed web apps and REST APIs are covered by AWS DevOps Agent release testing, summarizes pass/fail and flaky trends, and surfaces coverage gaps for uncovered services. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (a custom test/CI MCP and the Agent Toolkit for AWS) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on TUE at 06:00 UTC
